policy: No further edits to active supervise_v4.py. Future orchestration changes must use a separately reviewed v5 file before any restart. Trials continue uninterrupted.

launch.snapshot_provenance: Reconstructed after launch by reversing exactly the recorded post-launch safety patch; not captured directly at launch.
launch.limitation: No direct access to process memory was used; version identity follows launch time and the single known subsequent file patch.

safety_version.provenance: Exact copy of current supervise_v4.py after the only post-launch patch.
safety_version.load_scope: Subsequent stage child processes load this safety version from the frozen active path. Existing supervisor and current stage continue their launch version in memory.
safety_delta: All-language active-record rejection before future stage dispatch.
All fixed audit hashes verified during every future stage locked report initialization.
